verdict.rationale: Paperspace's API-key docs name an official "Core JavaScript SDK" that API keys work with, so a first-party SDK exists. That is the only mention, though: no SDK reference docs, install instructions, language coverage or maintenance status appear. The OpenAPI spec and the CLI are building blocks or adjacent tools, not SDKs, and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK documentation and reference, SDKs in other languages (e.g. Python), evidence the JavaScript SDK is current rather than legacy "Core" tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: API keys let you interact with Paperspace through the Core RESTful API, the Core JavaScript SDK, and Gradient command-line utility (CLI).
